title: Dashboard, Billing, Analysis, and Settings TanStack Query cache lifecycle

acceptanceCriteria.description: Dashboard, Billing, Analysis, and Settings GET loads use endpoint-shaped TanStack Query keys and retain backend DTOs as the business source of truth.
A fresh Dashboard to Orders to Dashboard remount renders cached data and performs zero repeated Dashboard GET requests.

The four view-key roots have a five-minute stale window, thirty-minute retention, fresh-cache reuse, stale-remount background refresh, and explicit invalidation behavior without changing Orders query defaults.
Strict TypeScript, the production frontend build, failure-state checks, the complete source-of-truth guard pack, and the full Dashboard browser proof pass.
Read-only production pressure snapshots recorded no new calls for the four historically busiest order-list fingerprints across 249 seconds.
The exact implementation SHA is deployed successfully to Vercel and the Render API, whose public health and readiness endpoints are healthy.

canonicalOwners: Backend Dashboard, Billing, Analysis, and Settings endpoints/read models own every customer-visible business DTO and value
web/src/lib/query-client.ts owns frontend cache freshness, retention, remount, and focus-refetch policy
Each view owns endpoint-shaped query keys, loading/error presentation, and mutation-triggered invalidation only

oldOwners.path: view-local imperative GET effects that discarded state on unmount
oldOwners.delegatesTo: TanStack Query cache entries under dashboard, billing, analysis, and settings roots

wrappers.delegatesTo: backend query functions for data while owning cache lifecycle only

sotBypass.details: No business totals, rates, labels, billing, inventory, authorization, or shipped/cancelled decisions moved into React. The frontend caches and renders backend DTOs without recomputing authoritative values.

evidence.proves: The real QueryClient returns one queryFn result across a fresh revisit for every target root, refetches after explicit invalidation, and exposes the scoped stale-remount defaults while preserving the conservative global default.
All three offline browser cases pass, including a request ledger that remains byte-for-byte unchanged after Dashboard to Orders to Dashboard navigation.

evidence.proves: All 49 mandatory backend-truth, rate, durable-worker, authorization, lifecycle, billing, inventory, and safety guards pass.

evidence.command: npm run audit:ps-448-query-pressure twice with a task-scoped read-only production connection on 2026-07-21
evidence.proves: Across snapshots at 06:48:51Z and 06:53:00Z, the top four historical order-list statement call counters remained 1,061,193, 902,647, 801,076, and 721,722. The script SELECTs aggregate pg_stat_statements metadata only.

evidence.command: Read-only GitHub/Vercel and Render deployment inspection plus GET /health and GET /health/ready on 2026-07-21
evidence.proves: GitHub deployment 5534127414 reported Vercel Production success and Render deploy dep-d9fhhn37uimc73en1tf0 reached live, both for exact SHA 4541d4e2ea67e593803fad1b043304f935b01b8a. Public health returned status ok and readiness returned ready with three components.

The reviewed implementation is frontend cache policy, Settings key normalization, and verification only. It changes no backend, OrdersView, protected shipped/cancelled surface, migration, provider connector, or application data.

migrations.rollbackPlan: No schema or data rollback is required. Forward-revert 4541d4e2ea67e593803fad1b043304f935b01b8a and redeploy the reviewed revert SHA to Vercel and the Render API.

rollback.strategy: Forward-revert the packet commit and implementation SHA, push the reviewed revert to prepshipv4-stable, and redeploy Vercel and the Render API. No order, shipment, billing, inventory, label, or marketplace data mutation is part of rollback.

liveVerification.reason: The exact implementation SHA is successful in Vercel Production and live on the Render API. Public health and readiness are green. Verification used only mocked browser traffic, deployment metadata, public health GETs, and aggregate pg_stat_statements SELECTs.

caveats.description: npm run test:master:quick was 18 of 20 green. test:daily-orders-trend-count reproduces at base SHA 9a676317 because its payload-type expectation is already stale; test:batch-header-package-size reproduces at base without required environment values and passes on the PS-448 tree with inert offline values. Neither failing path is changed by PS-448.
